closeOrg.sectionBody: The company closes and the team can no longer sign in to it. Data is kept for {{days}} days; during that time you can reopen the company. After that, everything is permanently deleted.
closeOrg.title: Close {{org}}?
closeOrg.listTeam_one: {{count}} person on the team loses access to the company and its tools.
closeOrg.listTeam_other: {{count}} people on the team lose access to the company and its tools.
closeOrg.listTeamAll: Everyone on the team loses access to the company and its tools.
closeOrg.listData: Invoices, measurements, disputes and files are kept for {{days}} days.
closeOrg.listReopen: You can reopen the company until {{date}}; after that it is permanently deleted.
closeOrg.nameLabel: To confirm, type the company name:
closeOrg.closedBody: Closed on {{closedAt}}. Data is kept until {{purgeAfter}}; you can reopen the company until then. After that, everything is permanently deleted.
closeOrg.reopenBody: The company opens again and the team gets back the same access it had before it was closed.
closeOrg.reopenPasswordHelp: This action is confirmed with your password.
closeOrg.reopened: {{org}} has been reopened. Your team has the same access as before it was closed.
closeOrg.goneBody: The company was reopened, its retention period ended, or you are not its owner.
closeOrg.noOrgHint: Company you closed: {{org}}. You can reopen it until {{date}}.

err.name: The name you typed does not match the company name.
err.ownerOnly: Only the company owner can close the company.
err.purged: The retention period has ended and the data was permanently deleted. The company cannot be reopened.
err.notFound: This company was not found, or you cannot reopen it.
